Packet assembled and uploaded to the secure drive link. Summary of included artifacts (zipped as Redwood_DR_Packet_Silverline_20261012.zip):

1) runbook_DR_run_2026-09-25.pdf — full sanitized runbook (internal creds removed)

4) failover_ticket_DF-2734.pdf — incident ticket summary with owner, runbook step references, and timeline
5) tabletop_cert_signoff_20261012.pdf — signed PDF with participant list (names + roles), acceptance statement, and sign-off timestamp 2026-10-12T23:02:10Z UTC

Key RTO/RPO measurements (from Markus' timing extract included in the ops_summary.txt inside the zip):
- Measured RTO (end-to-end service restore under rehearsal conditions): 00:12:37 (hh:mm:ss) from cutover start to successful health-check across 6 endpoints
- Measured RPO (data loss observed): near-zero — KV cache served last-write within 4s of cutover; S3 object timestamps indicate no data lag for the tested window

Chain-of-custody note: all artifacts were exported from our audit node (a read-only snapshot) and checksummed via SHA256; checksums.txt included.

Related references: JIRA DF-2734 (failover ticket), DocuSign link for signoff.

Attachments: restore_job_2734-logs.tar.gz, s3_warm_cache_report_20260925.csv, failover_ticket_DF-2734.pdf, tabletop_cert_signoff_20261012.pdf
